ideas.pitch: A machine learning platform built specifically for Indian agriculture to forecast crop yields and detect early blight anomalies from regional soil and weather telemetry.
ideas.problem_statement: Agriculture domain challenge focused on data-driven solutions for farm yield and health monitoring.
ideas.title: AgriYield-ML: Regional Crop Disease and Yield Forecasting Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the Agriculture domain requested by the School of Data Science, leveraging tabular machine learning and anomaly detection patterns proven in dengue and IoT forecasting wins.

ideas.pitch: An XGBoost-powered clinical dashboard predicting patient readmission rates equipped with SHAP value visualizers for instant doctor-facing medical interpretability.
ideas.problem_statement: Healthcare domain challenge focusing on predictive modeling and clinical data interpretation.
ideas.title: ClinicReadmit-X: Explainable Patient Readmission Risk Scoring
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates a proven 1st place medical hackathon architecture by combining high-accuracy gradient boosting with clinical explainability (SHAP), which heavily appeals to academic and healthcare judges.

ideas.pitch: An automated exploratory data profiling and anomaly detection tool that ingests smart city sensor logs to catch pollution spikes and traffic congestion bottlenecks.
ideas.problem_statement: Smart Cities and Environment domain challenge utilizing data analysis and AI/ML model development.
ideas.title: UrbanAir-Flow: Smart City Traffic & Emission Anomaly Profiler
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies an automated data profiling engine that performs rigorous data integrity checks and anomaly detection, matching the runner-up pattern for automated EDA and data engineering tools.

ideas.pitch: A Natural Language Processing pipeline that automatically categorizes, prioritizes, and extracts root-cause summaries from financial consumer complaint datasets.
ideas.problem_statement: Finance domain challenge applying machine learning and natural language processing to real-world complaint data.
ideas.title: FinComplaint-AI: Consumer Grievance Auto-Tagger and Sentiment Sorter
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly mirrors a 1st place data science solution built for consumer complaints databases, utilizing robust NLP text preprocessing and classification.

ideas.pitch: A data profiling and fairness auditing platform that evaluates educational assessment data for hidden demographic biases and consistency issues.
ideas.problem_statement: Education domain challenge focusing on data analysis, interpretation, and fairness in machine learning.
ideas.title: EduProfile-Audit: Student Performance Integrity & Bias Checker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines data profiling with algorithmic bias detection—a winning combination from recent data science hackathons that highlights ethical AI practices for academic evaluators.
